project.name: alvarmaciel.github.io
project.description: Personal website for Alvar Maciel with bilingual content, blog posts, bio pages, media section, and a podcast-style section for Lento es normal.
project.repositoryPurpose: Personal site and publishing hub hosted through GitHub Pages.

bio.description: Bio/about pages with Spanish and English variants.

posts.description: General blog posts. Some are multilingual via .es.md/.en.md files; others are plain leaf bundles with index.md.

media.description: Media-related sections. Currently includes Lento es normal.

lentoEsNormal.description: Podcast/radio-column style section. Contains the Lento es normal episodes/posts and has a custom RSS template.

existingArchiveShortcode.description: Embeds a responsive Archive.org audio player iframe with a link to the Archive.org item. Supports optional height parameter.

recommendedFrontMatterForAudio.audio: Keep as a list of URL strings for compatibility with Hugo themes/OpenGraph.
recommendedFrontMatterForAudio.enclosures: Use for rich RSS enclosure metadata: url, type, length.
recommendedFrontMatterForAudio.tags: Can be copied from Archive.org metadata.subject.

archiveOrgMetadata.durationSource: files[].length, duration in seconds converted to MM:SS or H:MM:SS

features: Multilingual Hugo site with Spanish as default language
Media section with Lento es normal
Custom RSS for Lento es normal podcast-like section with iTunes tags, content:encoded, enclosures support, and audio fallback
Responsive Archive.org embed shortcode for audio
Archive.org metadata helper script for front matter snippets

knownIssuesOrCleanupItems.details: Root hugo.toml contains generic placeholder values while config/_default/hugo.toml appears to contain the real configuration. Confirm which config GitHub Actions uses.
public/ contains generated output. Avoid editing manually unless explicitly requested. GitHub Actions builds and publishes public/ to gh-pages.

knownIssuesOrCleanupItems.issue: Podcast RSS should be validated after changes
knownIssuesOrCleanupItems.details: layouts/media/lento_es_normal/rss.xml now supports Params.enclosures with length/type, fallback to Params.audio, and content:encoded. Validate with hugo and a podcast feed validator after RSS changes.

agentGuidelines: Read this file first when starting work on this repository.
Do not assume the Radio San Javier program/CMS structure applies here; this is a personal site with a media/podcast section.
Prefer edits in content/, layouts/, scripts/, docs/, or config/_default/ before touching theme files.
Do not edit themes/blowfish/ directly unless explicitly requested; use project-level overrides.
Do not manually edit public/ unless explicitly requested; it is generated output.
Keep user-facing Spanish content in Argentinian/Rioplatense Spanish unless asked otherwise.
When adding Archive.org audio metadata, keep Params.audio as a list of URL strings; put rich RSS enclosure metadata in Params.enclosures.
For RSS enclosure length, use Archive.org files[].size, not files[].length.
For podcast duration, use Archive.org files[].length converted from seconds.
Use scripts/archive_metadata.py <identifier-or-episode-file> to print YAML snippets for Archive.org audio, enclosures, duration, image, archive fields, and tags.
Archive audio usage is documented in docs/archive-audio.md.
Before changing RSS behavior, inspect layouts/media/lento_es_normal/rss.xml and existing content under content/media/lento_es_normal/.
